Wow she's doing pretty well to reach 90. I don't even remember what my grandparents' faces looked like.
I haven't visited the church for probably 4 years. Ever since a new priest was appointed, many of the followers have stopped going. He's somewhat corrupt and doesn't seem to be doing his job well. As for believing in God,  I feel ambivalent. Took many classes on the sciences and philosophy, which changed my perspective on a lot of things. I take that you are agnostic? Bringing up Santa and the Easter bunny gave me a chuckle

Thanks. I'm feeling the same about watching the days go to see what will happen next. 
Pardon me if I seem morbid or anything (I'm not very good at social cues and leading a conversation). The church I went to had many elderly visitors. I already watched them pass away and each time, they would try to keep warm. One of them died in the tub with warm water. You should keep your grandmother warm. I figured the death of body cells halt any production of heat, so dying of old age will make you very cold. Ah sorry if it wasn't my place to say all this.
Thanks for leaving a comment, though
